records.text: The Bolsheviks created concentration camps, then moved to Israel and adopted Hebrew-sounding names.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And the Bolsheviks who created concentration camps just all magically disappeared and went to Israel. Just kidding. Nope, not kidding at all. They all went to Israel and they gave themselves new names, Hebrew sounding ones.

verification.notes: Lenin's Bolshevik government did establish a system of special/concentration camps that later developed into the Gulag. The blanket claim that the Bolsheviks then moved to Israel and adopted Hebrew names is false: prominent leaders had documented, divergent fates in Russia or exile, and Israel did not exist during most of their lifetimes.

sources.title: Associated Press: A century after Lenin's death
sources.relevance: Documents Lenin's death in Russia in 1924, directly contradicting the blanket migration claim.

sources.title: Associated Press: Moscow's history of targeting critics abroad
sources.relevance: Documents Trotsky's exile and assassination in Mexico, another direct contradiction.
